message.content: {"question":"Some amount of water vapor at a temperature of 110 C is mixed with a block of ice with a mass of 30 g at a temperature of -20 C in an insulated container. How much vapor (mass m) was used, considering that the final temperature of the mixture is 20 C? (The mass of the container can be neglected.) (latent heat of fusion LF = 80 cal/g, latent heat of vaporization LV = 540 cal/g and the specific heat as CI = 0.50 cal/g for ice, Cw = 1.00 cal/g for water, CV = 0.48 cal/g for vapor)","options":{"A":"m =5.30 g","B":"m =0.53 g","C":"m =53 g","D":"m =2.65 g"},"correct":"A"}
